apple.name: Talyn
apple.subtitle: Your coding agents, anywhere
apple.description:
Talyn keeps your coding agents working while you are away from your desk. Agents run Claude Code and Codex in cloud sandboxes on your own Claude or ChatGPT plan. Talyn on your phone lets you follow them, answer them and keep their pull requests moving.

FOLLOW YOUR SESSIONS
See every session and thread at a glance: which agents are working, which finished, and which need an answer from you. Open a session to read its transcript and the changes it made.

ANSWER AND STEER
Reply to an agent, give it a new instruction, or stop a turn. Start a new session on one of your repositories.

KEEP PULL REQUESTS MOVING
See the pull requests that need you: failing checks, review requests and merge conflicts. Read the diff, approve or request changes, ask an agent to fix a failing check, and add a pull request to the merge queue.

NOTIFICATIONS WHEN YOU ARE AWAY
Talyn sends an alert when an agent finishes, needs an answer or opens a pull request. When you are at your computer with Talyn open, your phone stays quiet.

Talyn works with GitHub. Sign in with your GitHub account. To run agents, connect your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription in Talyn.
apple.keywords: pull request,code review,coding agent,ai agent,developer,merge queue,sandbox,git,devops,ci

reviewAccess.account: Email tom@todiex.com (the talynreviewer GitHub account, with a Talyn password for the review sign-in; the store owner enters the password)
reviewAccess.notes:
To sign in: on the sign-in screen, press and hold the Talyn owl for 2 seconds. A "Review sign-in" form opens. Enter the email and password from the sign-in fields of this review.
Why: Talyn normally signs in with GitHub only, because it is a client for GitHub repositories and pull requests (App Review Guideline 4.8, exception for a client of a specific third-party service). GitHub asks a new device for a code sent by email, which a reviewer cannot read. The form exists for review only; only the review account has a password.
Running a new agent needs a Claude or ChatGPT subscription that the person connects. The reviewer can read sessions, threads, transcripts and pull requests without one.
The app sells nothing. Plans and usage are shown only; there is no purchase, upgrade or external payment link in the app.
Account deletion: Settings > Delete account.

apple.releaseNotes: The first release of Talyn for iPhone.
